facts.text: I am trying to improve my Instagram engagement.
I recently collaborated with an influencer who promoted my product to her 10,000 followers.
My target audience is young adults who are interested in unique accessories.
I use keywords related to my product including "handmade jewelry", "unique accessories", and "indie fashion".
I want to create an Instagram story that will engage my followers.
I have been using Instagram stories to give my followers a sneak peek into my production process.
I have been using Instagram stories to ask for feedback on new products.
I experimented with polls in Instagram stories.
I did a poll last week asking my followers to vote for their favorite product design.
Around 50 people voted in my poll.
I am planning to run another Facebook ad campaign soon.
I want to target people who have shown interest in similar products to mine on Facebook.
I previously ran a Facebook ad campaign that reached around 2,000 people.
My previous Facebook ad campaign resulted in 50 clicks to my website.

events.text: Collaborated with an influencer who promoted the product to her 10,000 followers
Ran an Instagram story poll asking followers to vote for their favorite product design
Planned to run another Facebook ad campaign
Previous Facebook ad campaign reached around 2,000 people and generated 50 website clicks
